description: This file provides functions for masking and unmasking Markdown content by replacing inline code, links, and URLs with placeholders, as well as validating placeholders.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks inline code, link URLs, and other Markdown elements in the input text by replacing them with placeholders.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Helper function that replaces matches of a given regex with placeholders and updates the mapping.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Replaces link URLs in text with placeholders and updates the mapping.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Restores original content in text by replacing placeholders with their original strings.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Checks if all placeholders are present in the given text.
